column1: # Per-instance and DATED. Pattern/regex suppression is FORBIDDEN — the next genuine instance
# would hide behind the same pattern (PAT-035 enforcer-blindness).
# EXPIRED ROWS RE-FLAG THEMSELVES BY DESIGN, so a quiet run means genuinely quiet.
# A malformed row, or a row with an empty anchor, suppresses NOTHING and the check says so.
# KEYED ON (file, token, ANCHOR-substring) — deliberately NOT on a line number.
# v1 keyed on path:line and broke the same day it shipped: editing MEMORY.md shifted its
# lines and every registered row stopped matching, re-flagging correct history as if new.
# A line number is not an identity. The anchor survives edits ELSEWHERE in the file but
# stops matching if the registered sentence itself is rewritten — which is wanted, because a
# rewritten sentence deserves a fresh look.
# anchor = a distinctive substring of the flagged line (keep it short and stable)
